findings.motion: SB 1174 Senate Third Reading, Assembly floor
findings.note: SB 1174 (Min, Elections: voter identification) bars a city or district from enacting or enforcing a charter provision, ordinance or regulation requiring a person to show identification to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place, vote center or other ballot location. Chaptered as Chapter 990, Statutes of 2024. Vote record is from CalMatters Digital Democracy; the official leginfo site blocked automated access.

AB 1116 (Berman, Elections: voter registration) lets a person register online without a California driver license or state ID if they give the last four digits of their Social Security number; the Secretary of State may verify identity from those digits, full name and date of birth; operative 2029. Vote record is from CalMatters Digital Democracy; the official leginfo site blocked automated access.
